title: GPU Operations
description: Per-card utilisation and memory, DCGM fault signals, the operator's quarantine transitions and Kueue's GPU quota. Every series is checked against what this repository's components emit by test/monitoring/monitoring_test.go.

panels.title: GPU utilisation by card
panels.description: DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL is the share of the last sample period in which a kernel ran, sampled once a second. A workload whose bursts share that period can read as idle in every sample (docs/06_OBSERVABILITY_BENCHMARK_FAILURE.md, 'What DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL cannot see'). max by card collapses the per-Pod copies the exporter's Kubernetes mapping adds.

panels.title: Framebuffer memory used by card
panels.description: DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED, in MiB. Only the exporter from config/dcgm-exporter-ops collects it; config/dcgm-exporter and config/dcgm-exporter-fault do not, and against them this panel is empty rather than zero.

panels.title: Cards with a fault signal now
panels.description: The GPUFaultSignalPresent policy: a non-zero Xid other than the application Xids 13, 31, 43, 45 and 68, or a double-bit ECC count above zero. Reads 0 only while the fault fields are being scraped; with no fault field anywhere it says so instead, because zero faults and no observation are different facts.

targets.expr: count(max by (Hostname, gpu, UUID) ((DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS != 0 != 13 != 31 != 43 != 45 != 68) or (DCGM_FI_DEV_ECC_DBE_VOL_TOTAL > 0))) or (0 * count(count by (UUID) (DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS)))

panels.title: Cards reporting the fault fields
panels.description: Cards whose exporter publishes DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS. Compare with the number of cards in the utilisation panel: a card missing here is one whose faults nothing would see.

panels.title: Last Xid by card
panels.description: DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS holds the last Xid only, so a later application Xid replaces an earlier fatal one here; the operator latches the fatal one and this panel does not.

panels.title: ECC error counts by card
panels.description: Volatile counts since the driver loaded. Double-bit errors are uncorrected and are a fault at any count; single-bit errors are corrected by the card and are never one here.

panels.title: GPU fault latches and clears since start
panels.description: The operator exports no gauge of which nodes are quarantined now: its NodeHealth metrics are counters of transitions since the process started, and a restart zeroes them while the taints stay. For the current state read the NodeHealth objects (GPUHealthy condition) or the nodes' platform.lkhun9311.github.io/gpu-fault taint. Empty until the fault path, --gpu-fault-source=dcgm, has latched or cleared something.

panels.title: Unhealthy-node taint transitions since start
panels.description: The readiness path's taint, platform.lkhun9311.github.io/unhealthy, applied and removed. A counter of transitions, not a count of nodes tainted now.

panels.title: Fault path scrapes by result
panels.description: The operator's own scrapes of each node's exporter. Any result other than ok means the fault path is not seeing that node, and its NodeHealth says GPUSignal=False rather than healthy.

panels.title: Workloads displaced and reactivated since start
panels.description: Kueue Workloads the operator deactivated off a faulted node and reactivated after, with --gpu-fault-evict-workloads.

panels.title: Kueue GPU quota and pending work
Kueue scraped
panels.description: Whether Prometheus reaches Kueue at all, through config/prometheus/kueue_monitor.yaml. Every other panel in this row is empty when it does not.

panels.title: GPU quota reserved and nominal, by ClusterQueue
panels.description: Summed over flavours. Kueue publishes these only with metrics.enableClusterQueueResources: true, which the release vendored in config/kueue-controller leaves off, so on that deployment this panel is empty and KueueGPUQuotaMetricsNotReported fires.

panels.title: Pending workloads by ClusterQueue and status
panels.description: active: in the admission queue. inadmissible: an admission attempt failed and Kueue will not retry until something changes. A count, not an age; KueueWorkloadsPendingTooLong reads it with the admission counter to say how long a queue has gone without progress.

panels.title: Admission wait p90, admitted workloads only
panels.description: Kueue observes this histogram when a workload is admitted, so a workload still waiting is not in it, and a queue that admits nothing shows no line rather than a long wait. Read it beside the pending panel, never instead of it.
